role: The TNT block (id 46): primed by flint and steel, by a burning arrow, or by redstone power; explodes as EntityTNTPrimed; drops itself when mined but not when destroyed by an explosion.

members.name: getIcon
members.note: The top, bottom and side icons; the mesh scenes compare every TNT vertex u and v.

members.name: onBlockAdded
members.note: the redstone-primed branch; no block ever receives power (world.conf redstone = off), so the body is dead

members.name: onNeighborBlockChange
members.note: same dead redstone branch; TNT stays put, as world.conf documents

members.name: quantityDropped
members.note: 1; falls to the dispatch's default self-drop rather than a named case 46

members.name: onBlockDestroyedByExplosion
members.note: primes an EntityTNTPrimed with fuse nextInt(fuse/4) + fuse/8 and the blast's placer

members.name: onBlockDestroyedByPlayer
members.note: Reached when a player breaks TNT, but it primes only when meta & 1 is set, which only a powered onBlockAdded or neighbour change writes: world.conf redstone = off. Survival TNT breaks with meta 0 and drops itself.

members.name: func_150114_a
members.note: The flint-and-steel prime (tnt.c:tnt_server_activate) and the burning arrow's (projectile.c); the redstone callers are the switch.

members.name: onBlockActivated
members.note: flint and steel primes and clears the block; the client half (the block cleared and the flint worn before the C08, which carries the worn stack) is survival.c:surv_client_use_pressed. The flint's damageItem(1, player) is surv_damage_stack (a worn-out flint's break draws and stat, the slot emptied as processPlayerBlockPlacement does); the client's half wears its copy through survival.c client_damage_stack.

members.name: onEntityCollidedWithBlock
members.note: EntityArrow.onUpdate's func_145775_I (projectile.c:arrow_block_collisions) hands a burning arrow's TNT cell to the living world's on_arrow_tnt: func_150114_a's primed TNT (the shooter as the placer when it is the player), then setBlockToAir. details-blocks-s1 shoots a Flame bow at a TNT block.

members.name: canDropFromExplosion
members.note: the false branch at explosion.c:452: no TNT item in the blast's drops

notes: The redstone priming branch (onBlockAdded, onNeighborBlockChange, and onBlockDestroyedByPlayer which only they call) is dead under world.conf redstone = off and marked n/a rather than missing. test_explosions.c exercises the explosion paths including TNT priming. lane/idxblocks: reviewed.
